jira_tickets.description:
The real origin IP 34.139.222.99 was discovered. This IP is not protected by the CDN and is directly reachable.

**Evidence:**


**Fix:**
Restrict origin access via firewall to only accept traffic from CDN edge IPs.

**Code Fix:**
```# AWS Security Group:
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-xxx --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 173.245.48.0/20```

Port 22 (SSH) is open. Exposed management/database services are high-risk for banking infrastructure.

**Evidence:**


**Fix:**
Restrict SSH access to internal IP ranges via firewall. Use VPN.

**Code Fix:**
```iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/24 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -j DROP```
